  let tool_use_id = Tool_contract.Invocation.tool_use_id result.invocation in
  let tool_result ~content ~outcome content_blocks =

  in
  match result.content_blocks with

       let content =
         if String.equal result.content ""

(* The passes [checkpoint_json_result] runs over the whole checkpoint,
   restricted to one message: encode, [Execution_json.validate] and a decode.
   Neither reads past the message's own subtree ([Execution_json.validate]
   checks keys and numbers inside each object, [messages_of_json] decodes each
   element alone), so a message that passes here passes inside any checkpoint.
   The decode reads the written bytes, with the handlers of
   [decode_current_json]. *)
let validated_message_encoding message =
  let json = message_to_json message in
  let* () = validate_checkpoint_json ~context:checkpoint_context json in
  let bytes = Yojson.Safe.to_string json in
  let+ decoded = decode_written_bytes ~decode:message_of_json bytes in
  { bytes; decoded }
;;

  =

  publish_summary ~canonical_path (summary_of_head ~identity ~objects:Objects_seen plan.head);

(* [written] is the value the files now hold, [None] when no value here
   describes them. *)
let keep_lineage ~canonical_path ~identity ~memo ~keeper_name written =
  match summary_key canonical_path with
  | None -> ()
  | Some key ->
    let owner = lineage_owner_of_key ~key ~keeper_name in
    let lineage_written =
      Option.map
        (fun written_checkpoint -> { written_identity = identity; written_checkpoint })
        written
    in
    let lineage_retained_bytes =
      saturating_add identity.size (Objects.memo_encoded_bytes memo)
    in
    update_lineage_state (fun state ->
      let entries =
        String_map.filter
          (fun other lineage ->
             String.equal other key
             || not (same_lineage_owner lineage.lineage_owner owner))
          state.entries
      in
      let lineage_access_seq = state.next_seq + 1 in
      let entries =
        String_map.add
          key
          { lineage_owner = owner
            ; lineage_memo = memo
            ; lineage_written
            ; lineage_retained_bytes
            ; lineage_access_seq
          }
          entries
      in
      evict_excess_lineages { state with entries; next_seq = lineage_access_seq }, ())

let forget_written_lineages ~session_root ~keeper_name =
  let forgets =
    match resolve_session_root session_root with
    | Ok resolved -> same_lineage_owner { owner_session_root = resolved; owner_keeper = keeper_name }
